derives_from: The frozen conformation-resolved accepted-hop replay matrix. Registered before replay results are observed.
identity: For a fixed set E, observed B inventory change minus the exact net B hop count equals the number of net I→B conversions inside E. The independent I inventory change gives the negative of that residual. This is an exact identity because exchanges do not add or remove materials and each I/B conversion changes the two counts with opposite signs.
summaries: Retain each seed, density threshold and endpoint mask. Sum signed inventory change, net I/B hops, and net I→B conversion across all qualified masks and intervals. Compare observations in driven and central reversible controls. Also report how often each signed term is positive, zero or negative rather than treating repeats as independent histories.
interpretation: Positive inferred conversion measures the combined net of both chemical pathways. Individual reactions need not be from the same particles that crossed the boundary. Mask choice remains observational.
